EmailTemplate.description: Email template used when we receive any email with the @insperity.com domain.
EmailTemplate.name: Health & Welfare Internal Email Template
EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for contacting Insperity’s Section 125 Team
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Thank you for your email. This email address is intended to be used only by external clients and internal teams who have not yet implemented Salesforce.
If you are a member of an internal team who accesses Cases in Salesforce, submit your future inquiries/requests as Cases in Salesforce. Click here to learn more about engaging the Section 125 Team and Health & Welfare Teams in Salesforce.
This email has been converted to Salesforce Case {!Case.CaseNumber} and will be handled in the order it was received. You can expect a response within 48 hours.
If you have an urgent matter or you would like to contact us by phone, please call us at 877-968-7474. Our hours of operation are from 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST, Monday through Friday.
Thank you,
Section 125, Health & Welfare Services
